structure.unit: Uniform Prudent Management of Institutional Funds Act

law.catch_line: Relation to Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act
law.text: This chapter modifies, limits, and supersedes the Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act, 15 U.S.C. § 7001 et seq., but does not modify, limit, or supersede § 101 of that act, 15 U.S.C. § 7001(a), or authorize electronic delivery of any of the notices described in § 103 of that act, 15 U.S.C. § 7001(b).
